items.title: Bob Lovett Interview, 1949-04-01
items.q: No, I think that was the only time I ever saw him or played with him.

ctx.x: G-E-R-O-U-L-D. Played the standard blues. G-E-R-O-U-L-D. Yes, he liked us very much, I remember.

G-E-R-O-U-L-D. You don't remember recording with Jimmy Yancey? G-E-R-O-U-L-D. No, I don't think we did. G-E-R-O-U-L-D. Were there other New Orleans people you know? Now you mentioned at the concert, Preston Jackson, did you ever work with him again? G-E-R-O-U-L-D. No, I think that was the only time I ever saw him or played with him. G-E-R-O-U-L-D. And Baby Dodds, do you remember working with him elsewhere?
G-E-R-O-U-L-D. I don't actually remember working with him anywhere else.
